summary: A whole set of teeth with its gums, painted for the character's teeth mesh.
_comment: The first FITTED Character article (Phase18 18.2, RD-P18-9): a set of teeth drawn for MakeHuman_Teeth_v01 (tools/converters/groups.py PART_MESHES), its picture its own base_color_map, sampled on the mesh's own UVs. One article on both parts of the teeth mesh, Teeth and Gums, as Eye_Natural is on three eye parts. The picture is MakeHuman's CC0 teeth atlas, each region held to its article's measured colour (Enamel_Natural, Gum_Natural), so the article's own colour is white: the picture is the colour. SUBSURFACE, so the gums scatter; the enamel at a short radius. sUKN: it tiles nothing (RD-P18-8). Enamel_Natural and Gum_Natural are kept. No tint port: Blender cannot yet draw a tinted base whose scatter follows its picture (F-SKM-23), as Eye_Natural carries none.
name: Teeth_Natural_Clean_Base_sUKN_v01

sources.why: The picture: MakeHuman's system assets (CC0, makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip sha256 b542127a...0107), teeth/teeth_base/teeth.png, made by tools/converters/fit/gen_fit_makehuman.py teeth: the enamel islands scaled per channel (x 2.32, 2.43, 2.20) so their mean linear colour is Enamel_Natural's (0.70, 0.67, 0.60), the gum islands (x ~1) to Gum_Natural's (0.194, 0.038, 0.045), then bled 16 px past the islands. The source's baked shadow between the teeth is kept; about 7 % of the island pixels clip at white. Provenance: library/provenance/sources/fit/makehuman/teeth.yaml.

One article for enamel and gum, so each value sits between their articles: IOR 1.5 (enamel 1.63, wet mucosa 1.4), roughness 0.25 (enamel 0.15, gum 0.3). Coat 0.5 at 0.1, IOR 1.336: saliva, as Gum_Natural. Scatter at half weight and a 2 mm radius with skin's radius scale: the gums glow, the enamel stays crisp (Gum_Natural scatters fully at 4.8 mm; Enamel_Natural is Opaque). Looked at in Storm and Blender on the rig's mouth view, and in Cycles on the thumbnail's, and passed by the maintainer (Phase18 clicks 2 and 3, 2026-10-15); Unreal not yet.
